<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a nucleophilic aromatic substitution (S_NAr) where a halide is replaced by an amine, forming a C‑N bond and breaking a C‑X (halide) bond. To locate such a template we can search the template catalog for reactions that break a halide functional group and form an amine functional group (and correspondingly break an aromatic C‑X bond and form a C‑N bond). Once we obtain a matching template we can return its mapped reaction SMILES and its template_id. We'll use the search_template_catalog_by_criteria tool with functional_groups_broken=["halide"] and functional_groups_formed=["amine"], and also specify the bond changes: bonds_broken=["6-7"] (aromatic C‑X) and bonds_formed=["6-7"] (aromatic C‑N).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1[N+](=O)[O-])Cl", 
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-7"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-7"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
